statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
There is concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
CPT code 93226 is a continuous ambulatory Holter monitoring study
The service was billed with diagnosis codes I48.91, G45.9, and I47.1
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
